from functools import partial as bind

from mailman.interfaces.listmanager import IListManager
from zope.component import getUtility

JOIN = "reading-group-join@local.edu"; LEAVE = "reading-group-leave@local.edu"

    if MLIST is None:

        MLIST = getUtility(IListManager).get(LIST)
    return MLIST
def retry(f, retries=8, delay=2):
    for i in range(retries):
        try: return f()
        except Exception:

            sleep(delay)
def send(body, subject, frm, to):

    with smtplib.SMTP("localhost", 25) as s: s.send_message(m)

        cands = [m for m in mbox if (m.get("From") or "").startswith("reading-group-confirm")

        assert cands, f"no {contains} mail for {user}: {[m.get('Subject') for m in mbox]}"
        msg = cands[-1]
        print(f"   confirm From={msg.get('From')} Subject={msg.get('Subject')}")
        send("", "", f"{user}@{DOMAIN}", msg.get("From"))
    return _
def new_user():

def member(u): return get_mlist().members.get_member(f"{u}@{DOMAIN}")

for u in (u1, u2):
    send("", "", f"{u}@{DOMAIN}", JOIN)
    retry(bind(confirm, u, "join"))
    retry(lambda u=u: (_ for _ in ()).throw(AssertionError("not member")) if member(u) is None else None)
    print(f"  {u} joined OK")

        mbox = mailbox.mbox(f"/var/mail/{u}")

print(f"  {u2} left OK")

sleep(8)
m2 = mailbox.mbox(f"/var/mail/{u2}")
got = any("Second announcement." in str(m.get_payload()) for m in m2)

retry(seen_nonmember)
print("  non-member post distributed OK")
print("ALL LEAVE/POST CHECKS PASSED")

#!/bin/sh
# Start the reading-group mailing list server (Mailman 3 + Postfix).
# Safe to run repeatedly; it is the boot/restart entry point for this container.
set -u
export PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
CFG=/etc/mailman3/mailman.cfg
aslist() { su -s /bin/sh list -c "cd /var/lib/mailman3 && $*"; }

mkdir -p /var/lib/mailman3/data /var/lib/mailman3/queue /var/lib/mailman3/lists \
         /var/lib/mailman3/locks /var/lib/mailman3/cache /var/lib/mailman3/archives \
         /var/lib/mailman3/templates /var/lib/mailman3/messages /var/lib/mailman3/ext \
         /var/log/mailman3 /run/mailman3
chown -R list:list /var/lib/mailman3 /var/log/mailman3 /run/mailman3 2>/dev/null

aslist "mailman -C $CFG start" || aslist "mailman -C $CFG restart"

postfix check || true
postfix status >/dev/null 2>&1 && postfix reload || postfix start

echo "reading-group@local.edu ready (mailman on 127.0.0.1:8024, postfix on :25)"
